articles.title: Karan Aujla Teases Upcoming Track with Exclusive Instagram ‘Frames’ Sticker
articles.text:
Karan Aujla, the acclaimed Punjabi musician famed for his lively and infectious tunes, has just offered a tantalizing preview of his forthcoming track by utilizing Instagram’s newly-released ‘Frames’ sticker. He stands among the select few worldwide to secure early access to this innovative feature.

Karan Aujla’s songs have been a sensation on Reels on Instagram. His tracks ‘ Softly ’ and ‘ Admirin’ You ’ have had over 1 million and 480,000 reels created with it. Now, fresh from his win at the prized Juno Awards, he shared an image of his upcoming track ‘ Goin’ Off ‘ using the new ‘Frames’ sticker on Instagram. The song embodies Karan’s style, filled with motivation and a bit of a gangsta vibe. It’s scheduled to be released this month.

With the ‘Frames’ sticker, you can turn any photo into a polaroid, which can be revealed once you shake your phone.

“I’m stoked to share this fun and new creative tool from Instagram with the world, and especially with my fans. As an artist, I’m always looking for new ways to engage my audience, and now my 6 million+ followers can just shake the phone with this new Frames sticker, and get a glimpse of my upcoming tracks!” – Karan Aujla

Steps to use the Frames sticker:

When creating a story, tap the stickers icon, then tap on the Frames sticker.

This will open up your photo gallery, where you can select one image to be framed.

Once you select an image, you can also add a caption if you choose. It will automatically add the date and timestamp of when the photo was taken.

After you post your story, your friends and followers can shake their phones or tap the ‘shake to reveal’ button to develop the image inside the frame.

This feature will be visible in your Stories tray and will roll out to everyone in India in a few days.
